title: Tesla
visualIntent: Tesla should be treated as a category-correct reference system for car-commerce, using minimal, premium, futuristic as the guiding visual attitude.

compositionRecipes.label: Tesla default
compositionRecipes.whenToUse: Use this as the default build recipe whenever Tesla is the locked primary reference.
compositionRecipes.heroStructure: Build a keynote-style hero anchored by one dominant product object, quiet negative space, and a compact copy block that frames the object rather than competing with it.
sectionOrder: Image-led hero with one dominant vehicle or machine frame.
Story or performance chapter rather than a generic features grid.
Collection, gallery, or ownership section with curated product emphasis.
Booking, inquiry, or launch close with premium restraint.
compositionRecipes.headlineImageRelationship: Keep the headline framing the product from above, beside, or just over the object with disciplined restraint; only use overlap when it strengthens the product keynote feel.
layeringRules: Keep layering sparse and exact so the product remains dominant and the composition stays severe.
Use one dominant foreground relationship and one subordinate supporting layer; do not stack decorative layers without purpose.
Every overlap, crop, or z-index shift should strengthen the selected reference rather than adding generic drama.
compositionRecipes.typeScaleRelationship: Keep scale controlled and deliberate so one product frame or one precise headline leads the page.
compositionRecipes.paletteDistribution: Palette dominance should stay restrained, tonal, and disciplined, with accent color used sparingly.
compositionRecipes.imageFraming: Imagery should be vehicle-led, cropped with intent, and treated as the page’s emotional anchor instead of a supporting thumbnail.
compositionRecipes.asymmetry: Keep asymmetry restrained and category-correct rather than theatrical for its own sake.
compositionRecipes.ctaPosture: Keep CTAs sparse, exact, and product-native.

antiPatterns: Do not normalize the selected reference into a tidier generic startup homepage just because the prompt is broad.

exemplarCues.label: Keynote object framing
cues: One hero object dominates the viewport.
Headline and copy frame the object with severe restraint.
Supporting sections stay quieter than the hero.
